name: aegis-interruption-recovery
normal: There is a fire in the engineering building. Two people are trapped.
Create the incident and acknowledge it concisely.
correction: Correction: there are three people trapped.
Update the current incident; do not create a duplicate.
stress: There is a fire near the main gate. Please verify the situation.
Interrupt while AEGIS is speaking or waiting: Stop. The location is actually the north gate, and nobody is trapped.
The final spoken state must reflect north gate and zero trapped people; stale work must not become current.
